subject: Sandbox subsidy request + attestation for private VPC PoC
message_1_subject: Request: sandbox subsidy + attestation for private VPC PoC
message_1_body:
Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking my meeting last week. We're ready to run a Private/VPC PoC with Redwood but need two things to unblock procurement & security: 1) a short-term sandbox subsidy (credits) to cover the evaluation run, and 2) an attestation template from Redwood describing data isolation and retention controls we can attach to our security review.

High-level ask: temporary credits to cover up to ~60k tokens worth of run time and a 30–45 day trial window for an isolated VPC sandbox. Procurement wants the attestation + a short workshop to validate the private networking setup and logging.

Can you confirm if Redwood can provide conditional credits tied to a signed attestation and a joint technical workshop? We can share a checklist of the exact evidence we need.

Thanks,
Laura Kim
Head of IT Security
Acme Health

Attachment: (requested) — acme-security-checklist.xlsx
message_2_subject: Re: Request: sandbox subsidy + attestation for private VPC PoC
message_2_body:
Hi Laura —

Appreciate the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we can support a conditional sandbox subsidy tied to a signed attestation and a joint validation workshop. I've looped in Ben (sales lead) and Grace (security engineer) to coordinate the amount and evidence path.

Proposed next steps: 
- Redwood provides a draft attestation template (we'll attach).
- Schedule a 60–90 minute technical workshop next week to validate VPC peering, KMS setup, and audit log delivery.
- Upon workshop and a signed attestation, we provision a private sandbox and apply a one-time credit top-up (proposed range: 40k–80k token-equivalent; final amount is an internal approval).

Can you share the checklist you mentioned and preferred times for the workshop? We'll prepare an agenda.

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-attestation-template.pdf
message_3_subject: Internal: ACME subsidy approval range + signoff path
message_3_body:
Irene — quick internal note. Laura's request looks standard for a security-gated Private PoC. I recommend approving a 60k token-equivalent credit and a 30-day sandbox extension (we can convert to spend cap if needed). Conditions: signed attestation + completion of a validation workshop (Grace to run).

Risks/asks: 
- Grace: confirm minimal evidence set (logging endpoints, KMS key IDs, SOC2 excerpt).
- Dev: is there any quota or capacity gating for a one-off private sandbox in us-west-2 next week?

I'll log the proposed credit in HubSpot (https://hub.redwood.ai/deals/D-20270504-ACME-01) and route for manager approval — should be quick since it's under the promo threshold. If manager signs off, I'll prepare the DocuSign for the attestation.

—Ben
VP, Sales Operations

Related internal link: /ops/credits/approvals/PRO-2982
message_4_subject: Approved: conditional sandbox subsidy & workshop scheduling
message_4_body:
Hi Laura —

Thanks for the checklist — this is great and exactly what we need. Following internal review, Redwood will provide a conditional subsidy of 60,000 token-equivalent credits and a 30-day private sandbox extension, subject to the following:

1) Signed attestation (attached). We placed a copy in DocuSign for signature: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC123-attestation
2) Completion of a technical validation workshop where Redwood confirms: VPC peering, KMS/HSM key handling, audit log delivery, and role-based access controls. Grace will lead the session.

I've attached the attestation template and the proposed workshop agenda. Proposed slots for the workshop: Tue 2027-05-10 10:00–11:30 PT or Wed 2027-05-11 14:00–15:30 PT — please confirm which works. Once the attestation is signed and the workshop completes with a short acceptance note from your side, we'll provision the sandbox and apply the credits.

Attachments: acme-attestation-template.pdf, workshop-agenda.pdf, redwood-sandbox-invite.ics

Quick note: For procurement we converted the subsidy to a spend cap inside the private sandbox so it can't be used outside the PoC. The HubSpot deal has been updated: https://hub.redwood.ai/deals/D-20270504-ACME-01

If you want, we can include a short executive summary for your procurement folder after the workshop.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132
